_note: Operator disposition register for VULNERABILITIES (CVEs/GHSAs from ZAP/Grype/Dependabot). The build FAILS on any scanner-reported vulnerability of any severity that is not handled. A vulnerability is handled ONLY if it is (a) remediated/gone, or (b) dispositioned here, in force (review_by not passed; a record past review_by is treated as absent), as one of: 'false-positive' (the reason it is not exploitable lives inside the scanned artifact and it never was; a false positive naming a control does not pass), 'accepted' (will not fix, with the acceptance explanation), 'operational-requirement' (Rev5 term for the same decision, kept until the POA&M is retired), 'mitigated' (only with a mitigation in data/mitigations.json that the VDR shows in force), or 'vendor-dependency' (only while the scanner's fix state is not-fixed; an unknown fix state counts as fixable). 'under-investigation' and 'remediate' are recorded but do not pass. No disposition stops a deadline: an overdue vendor dependency or partly mitigated finding still fails the VDR's deadline gate. A risk-adjusted vulnerability still has a severity, so it does NOT pass. Config-scanner suppressions (Checkov) live in .checkov.yaml + the VDR maps, not here.
_note_poam_ref: Every entry MUST carry a 'poam_ref' naming the formal POA&M item that tracks it (an id in docs/poam.md, mirrored in data/poam-items.json). build-vdr-report.py copies the entry's disposition and poam_ref onto the matching VDR finding, which is what lets reconciliation invariant (h) — every VDR finding resolves to a POA&M item — hold for SCA/DAST vulnerabilities. A disposition without a poam_ref makes the vulnerability gate pass and the reconciliation gate fail; tests/test_vuln_gate.py asserts every entry here resolves.
_key_format: The key is the id the vulnerability gate resolves for the finding: its CVE when it has one, else the scanner tracking id (e.g. 'grype-{vuln-id}-{purl}', 'zap-{alert-ref}'), else the tool id.

CVE-2025-00000.justification: Vulnerable code path is not reachable in the deployed app; the package is a build-time-only transitive dependency.
